summary: CAE Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held August 12, 2026. All 13 director nominees were elected, including newly appointed director Bruce Ross, and PricewaterhouseCoopers was reappointed as auditor with 92.74% support. The advisory say-on-pay resolution passed with 94.35% shareholder approval. The filing is a routine post-meeting disclosure under Canadian National Instrument 51-102, containing no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation element. This is an administrative current report; no deal terms, strategic actions, or unusual governance events are present. What to watch: none — purely routine governance disclosure.
